## Description

Please describe what this pull request does and why. If it resolves an issue, write "Fixes #123" or "Closes #123" (with the issue number), so that the issue is closed automatically when the pull request is merged.

## Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm the following:

- [ ] I have read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/florianhartig/DHARMa/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I am the author of this contribution and take full responsibility for it. I have a full, independent understanding of every change proposed here and can explain and defend it.
- [ ] This pull request was **not** created autonomously by an AI agent or automated tool. *(Using AI as a personal aid is acceptable, but the contribution must be authored and understood by a human.)*
- [ ] Unless this is a trivial fix (e.g., a typo): the change was discussed in an issue before opening this pull request.
- [ ] If there is an issue: the branch name contains the issue number (e.g., `offsetProblemWithUpdate_351`).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests if the change affects package functionality.
- [ ] I have added or updated roxygen2 documentation if the change affects any exported functions.
- [ ] I have added an entry to `DHARMa/NEWS.md` that ends with the issue number (if there is one), if the change is visible to users.
- [ ] The automatic `R CMD check` on this pull request passes with no new errors or warnings.
